messages:
Kai: FYI customer reporting repeated partial SSE payloads then disconnects when requests flow through a gRPC -> HTTP/1.1 gateway. They see a 3x token billing spike after client reconnects.
Sara: Can you paste the minimal repro + headers we saw?
Kai: root cause reproducer attached by customer: their client opens H2 to our edge, edge forwards via internal gRPC gateway which translates to HTTP/1.1 to backend. When the gateway resets idle streams we get truncated chunked frames.
Kai: Customer says behavior: initial stream emits ~2-3 chunks, then gateway sends RST_STREAM, client reconnects and requests resume -> backend replays from last token and customer gets duplicates.
Ben: Ouch. Do we have ingress logs for that customer span? any 499/aborts?
Kai: logs: "ingress: stream closed abnormally: RST_STREAM (11)" repeated. Also a few 502 from gateway with "upstream prematurely closed connection".
Ingrid: Likely the gateway is converting h2 streaming to chunked h1 and relying on connection-level idle timeouts. When it tears the connection it doesn't synthesize trailers, client treats as truncated SSE and retries.
Ingrid: Quick repro steps I used locally to mimic:
Ingrid: 1) Run an h2 client to edge (nghttp2) -> edge -> envoy gRPC bridge -> backend.
Ingrid: 2) Configure envoy cluster to use http1 for upstream with `max_connection_duration` short and `drain_timeout`.
Ingrid: 3) curl --no-buffer -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" http://edge.local/stream -> watch truncation.
Ingrid: Example curl to simulate gateway translation:
Ingrid: ```
# simulate client over http/1.1 chunked stream to backend proxy
curl -i -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Connection: keep-alive" http://localhost:8080/stream
```
Sara: Can we get tcpdump + http traces from the gateway for the time window? Need to confirm whether RST comes from client->edge or the internal gateway->backend.
Kai: Collected pcap and envoy access logs, attaching gist: https://redwood.gists/abc123 (private). Shows gateway sending FIN without trailers, and backend logging EOF while writing.
Ben: For customer billing: they were charged for tokens on both attempts. We should offer credit while we triage. Assign support case 97621. support-bot: case 97621 opened for customer "Acme Corp"; priority P2.
support-bot: Suggested runbook: capture pcap on edge/gateway, collect envoy config (http1 codec settings, idle timeouts), reproduce with `nghttp` -> report.
Ingrid: Engineering suggestion: make resume idempotent by introducing a client-side resume token or server-side dedupe on sequence id. Short term we can advise: increase gateway keepalive, disable aggressive connection draining, or route streaming traffic direct to h2-compatible upstream.
Ben: I'll propose a credit and a recommended config to the customer. Sara, can you push the pcap and access logs to the ticket?
Sara: On it. Also adding a note for product: consider exposing a per-request resume idempotency header so reconnects don't double-bill.
Kai: Thanks team. Action items: (1) Ben: credits + comms, (2) Sara: logs -> case, (3) Ingrid: small repro + config diff to share with customer, (4) Support-bot: keep case open.
Ben: adding an interim mitigation email to customer: please use direct HTTP/2 path or increase gateway idle to >60s to avoid mid-stream resets. :+1:
Kai: marking thread for follow-up. :eyes:
